We are seeking an QA Automation Tester Consultant with minimum of 2-3 years of experience in the role to assess software quality through manual and automated testing. You will be responsible for finding and reporting bugs and glitches. You will part of our team located in Madrid with a In addition to Spanish and English speaking (the work will be in English).

7+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance.
7+ years of experience in test methodologies writing test plans creating test cases and debugging.
2+ years of experience in Automated testing using JavaScript/TypeScript/NodeJS.
Experience testing SaaS products.
Black box and white box experience and expertise.
Desire to learn new technologies.
Excellent written/oral English communication skills.

We are a Spanish company leading in technological services and attracting talent since 1995. We have more than 600 employees in both national and international projects in the IT sector.

qa, Automotion, Selenium, Cucumber

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
🔥🔍 We are on the hunt for exceptional QA Manual Testers to join our incredible team! Join us in shaping the future of TV! 📺🚀

📍 Location: Anywhere in Spain! Enjoy the flexibility of remote work from home! 🏡

Mission
• You will be part of our Agile TV Engineering team to bring recognized products and services to market, building the best TV experience, working closely with the product and development team (https://www.agile-tv.es/)
• Participate in the development of new products and evolution of the existing ones while understanding requirements and user stories for risk-based testing and influencing system design for reliability, performance, and testability.
• Collaborate in testing new features required to support frontend and backend modules and platform functionality and releases as well as investigate test failures in production, identify design flaws, and suggest potential solutions.

Your key daily tasks will be
• Design the sprint test strategy, prepare test cases for... sprint stories, validate "Done" Stories, and register and notify bugs.
• Collaborate with Product Owners to accept the Story, enhance client understanding, prepare and review stories, participate in the definition of Acceptance Criteria (from which Test Scenarios can be generated), develop a better understanding of the Business Domain, and identify dependencies between stories.
• Work alongside developers to define test strategies for the stories, detect and report bugs, provide early feedback on stories, and offer suggestions for functional and usability improvements.
• With other QAs and the operations team: design and prepare the overall testing strategy, identify the most vital business scenarios and flows, help to know the health of deliverables, identify dependencies, support in testing non-functional requirements and maintain and refactor system tests (end-to-end).

You Must Have
• 3+ years of experience in software testing.
• Android/Apple devices testing experience.
• API management experience (i.e., Postman)
• Frontend testing experience.
• Test Plan management.
• Experience in agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban, .) and task management tools (JIRA, Planio, etc.)
• Project documentation management (release notes, functional specs, test plan).
• C1 Spanish and B2 English level or equivalent.
• This position requires to be currently residing and have a valid working permit in Spain.

It Would Be Great If You Have
• Understanding of media/TV product and terminology (streaming, DRM, OTT, TDT, time shift).
• Familiar with Test plan tools and repositories.
• Knowledge with one or more of the following programming languages and related testing frameworks: Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, Python.
• Experience in software development best practices, including optimization, documentation, testing and code quality metrics and tools.
• Expertise handling software repositories and the GIT version control.

We Are Looking Forward To Hearing From You If

Collaborative team player : You thrive in a team-oriented environment, valuing the input of others and actively contributing to the collective success.🤝

Strong communication and organizational skills : You convey your ideas effectively and coordinate tasks efficiently, ensuring smooth collaboration within the team. 🗣️📋

Self-motivated and takes ownership : You demonstrate a proactive and responsible attitude, taking initiative and accountability for your work. 💪

Eager to learn and improve : You have a growth mindset, always seeking new knowledge and skills to enhance your capabilities. 📚📈

Hands-on and solution-oriented : You enjoy diving into practical tasks and finding creative solutions to challenges, bringing tangible results. 🛠️💡

Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities : You possess the aptitude to analyze complex problems, break them down into manageable components, and devise effective solutions. 🧠🔍💡

Results-oriented : You are driven by achieving objectives and delivering high-quality outcomes, focusing on measurable results. 🎯🏆

Flexibility and adaptability: You can adjust plans swiftly and respond effectively to changes, adapting to evolving circumstances. 🔄🌟

Why joining Agile Content?
• Thrilling Projects: Dive into exciting projects and products, surrounded by talented individuals and real technological challenges. There's never a dull moment!
• Impactful Innovation : Your family and friends will see the outcomes of your job. How terrific is that!
• Global Connections : Connect with some of the coolest brands and leading companies worldwide. Collaborate with diverse teams and expand your professional network.
• Work-Life Flexibility: We believe in the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy flexibility in terms of location and working hours to ensure harmony between your personal and professional life.
• Cultural Diversity: Experience a multicultural environment where colleagues come from different nationalities, cultures, and backgrounds. Embrace diversity and learn from each other.
• Continuous Learning : Empowerment is at the core of our culture. Engage in ongoing learning through industry events and summits. Stay updated with the latest trends and expand your knowledge.

We Offer

💸 Flexible Compensation Program : Tailor your compensation & benefits to meet your needs and preferences.

⌚ Schedule Flexibility : Adapt your working hours to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.

🏠 Work from Home: Enjoy the freedom and convenience of working from the comfort of your own home.

🎉 Birthday Off: Take a well-deserved day off to celebrate your special day.

☀️ Recharge 4 Fridays per year: Every quarter, indulge in a day dedicated to recharging yourself.

🌴 Extra Days Off: Celebrate work anniversaries with extra time off to relax and unwind.

🤝 Referral Bonus Program : Earn rewards by referring talented individuals to join our team.

🗣️ Free English Lessons: Enhance your language skills with complimentary English lessons.

_ _

At Agile Content, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We encourage all individuals from all backgrounds and identities to apply 🌈

jobs_results.title: Tester/QA con Selenium y Junit
jobs_results.description:
Te ofrecemos crecer con nosotros en una de nuestra unidad tecnológica Quality Assurance como QA/Tester en una posición estable y a largo plazo modalidad Hibrida en Madrid en una de las compañías punteras a nivel nacional e internacional. Si cuentas con a partir de 3 años de experiencia desarrollando pruebas con Selenium/Junit danos la oportunidad de conocerte.

¿Qué necesitamos?
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de pruebas con Selenium/Junit
• Conocimientos de programación Java
• Experiencias con un marco de automatización.
• Experiencia con GIT.
• Conocimiento de la configuración de los trabajos de Jenkins.
• Experiencia en el uso de Appium
• Ejecución de automatización en la nube
• TestNG Rayos X
• Inglés fluido B2

Funciones
• Supervisar los resultados de la automatización y diagnostique los fallos.
• Automatizar los casos de prueba y mantener la automatización actualizada.
• Definir la estrategia de automatización de los diferentes proyectos.
• Mantener una comunicación efectiva con... los proyectos asignados y los equipos de desarrollo.
• Apoyar el proceso de mejora continua mediante la puesta en marcha de acciones proactivas para aumentar la eficacia y eficiencia de la prueba.
• Promover reuniones periódicas de seguimiento y presentar los resultados a las partes interesadas.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación indefinida

Modalidad trabajo Hibrida en Madrid (3 días remotos y 2 días presenciales)

Rango salarial 30-38K b/a (en función de la experiencia y conocimientos del candidato).

Beneficios sociales Seguro médico privado y seguro de vida

Retribución flexible tickets restaurante tickets guardería tarjeta transporte

23 días de vacaciones y el día de tu cumpleaños

Plan de formación personalizado.

Si sientes que podrías encajar y te apetece la experiencia ¡ponte en contacto con nosotros! Y te daremos toda la información que necesites. ¡Abre una nueva ventana a tu futuro con Second Window! ¡Inscríbete!

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
️ **About the company**

WAME is the sports social platform that is revolutionizing the way young athletes connect with their teammates, families, coaches and other sport entities. Our mission is to empower sports institutions and young athletes everywhere to reach their full potential.

We do this with a huge variety of technologies, solutions, and infrastructure to reach the performance expected. We recently transitioned from an MVP to full production, which is an exciting time for the company.

We're embarking on a growth journey, building our initial teams. Your expertise will be crucial in the roots of the methodology. Enjoy a flexible work schedule and the option to work remotely two days a week in a dynamic environment.
• *About the role**

As a** QA Engineer**, you will contribute to achieving the highest quality and reliability for Wame's software. You will see the 'big picture' and help improve our platform. You are a team player who understands the importance of reliability... in the user experience.

As a part of a Squad, working in an agile environment, your mission will be to ensure the reliability and performance, guaranteeing the evolution from the current ecosystem of solutions to a platform capable of leading the sector.

We combine strategic viewpoints in engineering with continuous improvements and updates in a platform that wants to lead the sector.

Our tactical executions are always small and trustable. Improving the global system step by step in only one direction, never going back.
• *About you**
- You have solid experience in QA automation and functional testing (our technical stack includes Dart, Flutter, and Node.js).
- You have been working in an Agile environment using Scrum or Kanban in cross-functional teams.
- You are based on Madrid and comfortable in an international environment, where English is our common language.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information System, Telecom or 5+ years equivalent experience in an engineering role.
• *Our culture**
- Ownership: We want you to proactively identify improvement opportunities and take the initiative to propose and develop potential solutions to enhance the experience. We don't wait for instructions; we act as owners of the company's success.
- Customer obsession: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to exceeding their expectations and delivering solutions that address their unique challenges.We treat every customer interaction as an opportunity to demonstrate ownership. We don't seek quick wins; we invest in long-term relationships.
- Lead with Curiosity: Stay abreast of new technologies and developments, driving innovation and embracing emerging opportunities.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
